headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an overall effect size of 1.23 (95% CI: 1.05–1.44), suggesting that processed meat intake is associated with a higher risk of renal cell carcinoma. These findings were supported by low between-study heterogeneity (I² = 2.03%), indicating consistent findings across the included studies.
